WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        o.account_id,
        d.A3 as region,
        COUNT(*) as order_count
    FROM `order` o
    JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
with_overall_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        region,
        order_count,
        order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () as diff_from_overall_avg
    FROM order_counts
),
with_region_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        region,
        order_count,
        diff_from_overall_avg,
        AVG(diff_from_overall_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY region) as region_avg_diff
    FROM with_overall_avg
)
SELECT 
    account_id,
    region,
    order_count,
    diff_from_overall_avg,
    diff_from_overall_avg - region_avg_diff as excess_over_region_avg
FROM with_region_avg
WHERE diff_from_overall_avg > region_avg_diff
ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
